name: Kikenbi Neratte!? Haramase Gakuen 2
original_name: 危険日狙って!? 孕ませ学園2
source: Kazuhiko attends school with three beautiful girls. Sporty and boyish Kaoru, mysterious and quiet Yuki, and cute and childish Ruri. He doesn't just want to have sex with them, he wants to make them pregnant!
